entities.summary: Harry Juhani "Hjallis" Harkimo is a Finnish businessman, television presenter, and former sailor who has served as a member of the Finnish Parliament since 2015. Previously a member of the National Coalition Party, he left the party over disputes with leadership and founded his own political alliance, Movement Now.
